title: Remove clutter from a photo
description: Select a wire or a passer-by, examine the edited spot and, if needed, return to the original.

blocks.text: A wire or a stray object spoils one frame that has already been edited in another app. What is needed is a short detour: take the object out and return the image to the previous process without reprocessing the whole shot.

quote.text: Best retouching app available. I use light room mobile and Snapseed to edit my photos. When I need to remove a power line or other object, TouchRetouch is my go to app.

blocks.text: Carrying the edit through to a result

The person selects an area, compares the corrected patch with the original and, if needed, refines the edge. The other edits are kept. The result can be passed to a familiar editor or to the photo library.
Where the idea has an advantage

The first test is worth running on difficult edges: hair, jewelry, reflections. This idea already has direct counterparts; a new product has to show a noticeable advantage on a specific type of edit, or in how conveniently the file is handed on.
